slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-7″ or faster

note: PDR drive band spacing is .188″ (recommend two drive bands in case neck for concentricity) Tip length is .143″. Recommended use: Small to Big Game Hunting. FF= 1.065. The product page also says: "We created this 75gr Hammer HBC™ that requires a minimum of a 1-7″ twist so that guys with fast twist factory rifles could run a relatively heavy very high bc bullet."
